english.title: Bus operator fail to notify passenger of requirement to wear seat belt - RTA 1988
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being the operator of a bus **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), in which any of the passenger seats were equipped with seat belts, failed to take all reasonable steps to ensure that every passenger was notified of a requirement to wear a seat belt at all times when in a seat equipped with a seat belt and the bus was in motion
english.legislation: Contrary to section 15(B) of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

english.notes:
(i) Section 15B(2) of the Road Traffic Act 1988 provides that for the purposes of section 15B(1) a passenger may be notified only by an official announcement or an audio-visual presentation, made when the passenger joins the bus or within a reasonable time of his doing so or a sign prominently displayed at each passenger seat equipped with a seat belt.
(ii) An "official announcement" means an announcement by the driver of the bus, by a conductor or courier or by a person who is a group leader in relation to any group of persons who are passengers on the bus.
(iii) Regulation 4A of the Motor Vehicle (Wearing of Seat Belt) Regulations 1993 provides that the prohibition in section 15(3) of the Act does not apply to a child riding in a small bus which is being used to provide a local service (within the meaning of the Transport Act 1985) in a built-up area, or which is constructed or adapted for the carriage of standing passengers and on which the operator permits standing.
